messages:
Kara: Putting up a quick design review for invite + roles grid tweaks. Goals: 1) move the SSO note inline (not a modal), 2) make seat wording less ambiguous, 3) add a lightweight audit nav shortcut. Figma: https://redwood.ai/figma/rbac-inline-sso

Ben: Inline SSO sounds good. Q: where exactly? top of drawer under title, or as a small badge next to the Send button? I lean to top under title so its visible before send.

Sophie: Top under title + a small badge by the Send button is great for redundancy. Badge should be keyboard-focusable and open a tiny tooltip: "Org enforces SSO. Invited users must sign in with SSO." Tooltip link to org settings.

Andre: Accessibility note: tooltip must be reachable via keyboard and read by screen readers. Use a button with aria-haspopup and aria-expanded, and ensure the tooltip content is in the DOM (hidden with aria-hidden when closed). Also: drawer close needs to be first tabbable element. Repro currently: tab order sends focus to Save then out.

Kara: Good catch @Andre. Will move close button to first tabbable node and add a focus trap sentinel. Also will include aria-modal="true" on the drawer container.

Ben: Seats label issue: research showed admins think "Seats" = purchased seats. Suggest "Assigned seats" as main label and smaller subtext "active users assigned". In tight table mode show just "Assigned".

Sophie: Microcopy variants for SSO tooltip (pick one):
- clear: "This organization requires SSO. Invited users must authenticate via your SSO provider."
- compact: "SSO required. Invited users must sign in with SSO."
Which do we use where? long for confirm modals, compact for table badges.

A11yBot: Auto-check: contrast on badge in light mode is 3.6:1. Recommend darker background token. Also toasts need role="status" + aria-live="polite"; current ephemeral toasts get missed by screen readers. Increase toast duration when a screen reader is detected.

Andre: For audit nav shortcut: propose `g a` jump to Audit > Activity, and left/right arrows to step events when event detail is open. Add a subtle hint after first use in top-left. This helps reviewers scan log entries quickly.

Kara: Love the `g a` idea. I'll add the keyboard hint mock and a tiny "step" UI (chevrons) in the event pane. Also adding a sticky search bar for audit so filters persist while paginating.

Ben: Small CSV invite UX: include sample header in drawer (code block) and a dry-run validation step that shows row errors inline. Example header: `email,role_slug,expires_at` with date format note.

Sophie: VoiceOver note: when dry-run finishes, announce "Validation complete: 3 errors" via aria-live. Also make the per-row error buttons keyboard-focusable with accessible labels like "Row 3 error: unknown role".

Kara: Action items: 1) move SSO note under drawer title + badge on Send, 2) rename Seats -> Assigned seats (table compact label: Assigned), 3) fix focus order and aria-modal on drawer, 4) adjust badge color token and add focus-visible, 5) add `g a` audit shortcut + chevrons in event detail, 6) add CSV sample + dry-run + aria-live announcements. I'll update Figma and post a condensed spec + an API note for backend flags. Thanks :thumbsup:
